title: Live fast-path PIPE_DRAWN twin ships unpinned — deleting it passes every gate
detail: ODN-14 byte-identity now rests on two hand-synced sites in different packages. No automated check exercises the exec-side append — deletion is CI-silent, killing the shipped game's wire click and live/replay stream identity (this repo's own r5/r6 'wiring shipped unpinned' blocker class).
recommended_fix: Pin the wiring the settings_effect_wiring way: a parity/input test drives a drag-release with sim_events set to a scratch buffer and asserts Event{tick=inp.tick+1, tag=EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN} lands.

title: Fast-path event append falls outside the app's per-tick hash window, breaking the documented replay-identity
detail: The app appends PIPE_DRAWN between tick windows, so no app per-tick hash/stats window ever contains it, while harness/replay hash it inside the apply tick — the app stream is no longer replay-identical at wire-draw ticks, contradicting both comments.
recommended_fix: Defer the fast-path append to the apply tick's step boundary (inside the hashed window), or amend the 'SAME slice'/'replay-identical' comments to document the exclusion at draw ticks.

title: Coverage comments claim 'ALL FOUR kinds' fire in audio.dem, contradicting themselves and the guards
detail: audio.dem's consumer never sees NODE_SPAWNED (no growth), yet both comments headline 'ALL FOUR kinds' before admitting spawn lives elsewhere. A maintainer trusting the headline could drop audio_spawn.dem believing audio.dem covers spawn.
recommended_fix: Reword both: audio.dem proves crisis+arrival+wire; audio_spawn.dem proves spawn+wire. Drop the 'ALL FOUR kinds' phrase.
